verdict.rationale: Klaviyo's developer docs say you can pull data from Klaviyo to build dashboards, sync to other systems and analyze marketing performance. The MCP docs mention flow performance reports, so performance data is exposed programmatically. Scoped private keys/OAuth, SDKs and rate-limit headers support building a warehouse or dashboard sync. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of campaign/flow reporting endpoints and the metrics they return, export/pagination details for bulk warehouse loads, independent or hands-on corroboration.
